name: Andreas Schieder - Après le § 22 - Am 6
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Albania
part_text: 22a. Calls on Albania to fully respect the autonomy of the Orthodox Autocephalous Church of Albania and refrain from any actions that undermine its freedom of religious expression or its property rights; calls for an end to interference in ecclesiastical appointments and for dialogue with religious authorities to safeguard religious pluralism;
